def blocks(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=set((r,c) for r in range(10,45) for c in range(20,60) if a[r][c] in ('b','S','M','r'))
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for p in list(pts):
        if p in seen: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            q=stack.pop()
            if q in seen or q not in pts: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
            r,c=q
            for dr,dc in[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                if (r+dr,c+dc) in pts and (r+dr,c+dc) not in seen: stack.append((r+dr,c+dc))
        out.append((min(x[0] for x in comp),max(x[0] for x in comp),min(x[1] for x in comp),max(x[1] for x in comp),len(comp)))
    return sorted(out)
def timer(f): return sum(1 for r in range(64) if f.ascii.split('\n')[r][62]=='N')
for i in range(5):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print(f"R{i+1}:",blocks(current_frame),"t:",timer(current_frame),last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): print("TERM",last_action_result); break
